decision: Disqualified from the results of qualifying.
event_name: Date 27 April 2019 Time 22:45 2019 AZERBAIJAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 April 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 25), summoned (document 27) and heard the team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 10 exceeded the fuel mass flow.
offence: Breach of Article 5.1.4 of the FIA Formula One Technical Regulations.
penalty: Disqualified from the results of qualifying.
reason: The stewards reviewed the evidence from the Technical Delegate and heard from the team representatives.The Stewards find that the fuel mass flow exceeded 100 kg/hr during the fastest lap set by car 10.
rules_referenced: Article 5.1.4 of the FIA Formula One Technical Regulations
